units.source_text: 佛堂的布置装饰完毕之后，讲师进来了。

en.t: After the Buddhist hall had been arranged and decorated, the lecturer came in.
The people who were to burn the incense had all arrived as well.

units.source_text: 源氏也出席这法会，他走过三公主所在的西厢，向里面张望，但见这临时居处内甚拥挤，暑气迫人，有五六十个严妆的侍女群集其中。

en.t: Genji also attended the service; as he passed the western wing where the Third Princess was staying, he looked inside and saw that the temporary quarters were very crowded and stiflingly hot, with fifty or sixty beautifully dressed gentlewomen gathered there.

units.source_text: 那些女童竟挤出在北厢的廊下。

en.t: The young girl attendants had even been pushed out onto the veranda of the northern wing.

units.source_text: 各处安置着许多熏炉，香烟四溢，弥漫空中。

en.t: Many incense burners had been placed everywhere, and the fragrant smoke drifted in all directions, filling the air.

units.source_text: 源氏走近去，教导那些经验不深的青年侍女，说道：“凡空中熏香，必须火力轻微，使人不知道烟从哪里出来才好。

en.t: Genji went closer and instructed the inexperienced young gentlewomen, saying, "When scenting the air with incense, the fire must be kept low; it is best if people cannot tell where the smoke is coming from.

units.source_text: 烧得像富士山顶的烟一般浓重，便杀风景了。

en.t: If you burn it so thickly that it looks like smoke from the summit of Mount Fuji, it ruins the atmosphere.

units.source_text: 讲经说教的时候，必须全体肃静，用心听取教理，不可任意发出衣衫窸窣之声，行动起坐都要静悄悄的才好。”

en.t: When the sutras are being expounded and the teachings explained, everyone must be quiet and listen attentively to the doctrine; you must not let your robes rustle carelessly, and even your movements and sitting down should be done in silence."

units.source_text: 三公主夹杂在许多人中间，越发显得娇小玲珑，她平伏地躺卧着。

en.t: Among so many people, the Third Princess looked all the more small and delicate as she lay prostrate.

units.source_text: 源氏又说：“小公子在这里要吵闹，抱了他到那边去吧。”

en.t: Genji added, "The young lord will make a fuss here, so carry him over there."
